title: payroll.employee.joined, schema_version 1
description: Someone Payroll should pay: added the first time, work details refreshed when sent again (HR sends it on hire and on every change; any product that keeps staff may send it). Organizational facts only: pay, bank details and identity numbers are entered in Payroll itself.

employee_reference.description: The sender's own id for the person; later events name them by it.

employee_number.description: Kept as Payroll's number when free (HR's E-00001).
